title: Anthropic just launched tools to show companies what their AI spending is buying | TechCrunch
summary: Anthropic has focused on getting enterprise users to stick around and Wednesday announced a new suite of reporting tools designed to give those customers a more granular understanding of the value they get from their token spend.
